question: In September 2023, what multiplier was paid for ordinary overtime beyond the forty-hour week? Answer under the version of the overtime rate that was in force on that date.

members.why: explains three versions of overtime rate and their date ranges
the pre-2024-07-01 version, in force for September 2023, gives +50% for ordinary overtime beyond the 40-hour week
